sections.detail: Reviewed planning centerline enabled locally. GPS ETA and calculator-distance adoption remain disabled.

The former Class I Ann Morrison–Eagle listing crosses diversion-dam and whitewater-park hazards. Boise identifies a low-head dam below the designated floater takeout; a suitable through-route and exact Eagle exit have not been established. This listing is withheld from trip planning.

BLM identifies both Cabarton Bridge and Smiths Ferry access as private. Current permission, operating arrangements and exact landing locations still need confirmation. This corrected reach is held for access review.

The legacy takeout label does not establish whether it means the Parnell Recreation Site or the separate Horseshoe Dam Bridge access in BLM guide P03. Confirm the intended landing and route before planning.
Kirkham and Lowman are different launch locations. The former six-mile listing combined them; a specific legal landing and matching distance must be established before enabling this trip.

The high-resolution source includes an older meander across wooded ground upstream of Fullmer (canyon-part-4.png / canyon-part-5.png). Geometry checks alone pass, but visual alignment does not. Keep the access map and published mileage; obtain updated river geometry before drawing this path.
